note: Companions in the open world (roadmap item 52; core/game/game_companions.gd, checked by tools/check_data.gd). A hired companion (the party rules, GameParty) is given an order: follow (keep close to the heir), stay (hold where they stand), gather (work the nodes within `gather_radius` of where they stand: trees, herbs, bones and ore outcrops, one after another, into the family's stores) or guard (hold a post and go out to meet a threat that comes within `guard_radius` of it). The order is saved on the party member, only once it is not follow; where they stand is not saved (a sandbox puts them beside the heir). `step_all` is one state machine over the companions' agents and moves them `speed` tiles a tick by the same router and ground rules as creatures (GameBehaviour, GamePath). A gathered node gives its material, with the companion's class share (`classes`, 1 when not listed), once per `regrow_years` of the world's calendar. A class's guard share widens the reach of its post. Nothing here is random or fights: a guard meets a threat and tells the caller (an `alert` event); fighting in the open world comes later.
